summary: Fixed ledger/importer.py to parse CSVs with the standard csv module (quoted fields with commas, escaped "" quotes, embedded newlines) instead of naive line.split(","), and taught _parse_amount to strip thousands separators. Blank lines still skipped, header handling/column-order/case-insensitivity and parenthesised/dollar amounts preserved (all original tests pass). Verified the reported bank-export scenario end-to-end and added 3 regression tests; full suite: 8 passed.
